_source: Written by tools/playlist.py, which reads the six WordPress playlist pages and verifies every entry against Vimeo's oembed endpoint. Not hand-edited: a private hash typed by hand is exactly the bug this replaces.

item.slug: url key, e.g. renald-flores-sweden. What ?v= carries.
item.hash: the private hash. Unlisted videos do not play without it. Never empty.
item.title: from the playlist markup
item.subtitle: place, crop, scale, whatever the markup carries beside the title
item.person: consultant or farmer named in the markup
item.thumb: img/video/<slug>.jpg once tools/playlist.py has fetched it
item.source: the page this was read from
